parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 85 bpm with a narrow QRS and very deep S waves in V1–V3 (about 25–30 mm) plus tall R waves in V4–V5, so the Sokolow-Lyon sum is well above 35 mm; the concave ST elevation in V1–V3 fits LVH repolarization rather than STEMI, and there are no reciprocal changes or Q waves.
